items.title: After Spending Years Imagining Its World, The Witcher Developer CD Projekt Has Officially Started Work on Its New IP
items.summary: CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077, has officially finished imagining up a new world for us to play in. The “world vision” stage for its new IP, Project Hadar, has been completed and work has officially begun on turning those concepts into a video game.
items.content:
CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 , has officially finished imagining up a new world for us to play in. The “world vision” stage for its new IP, Project Hadar, has been completed and work has officially begun on turning those concepts into a video game.

"This has been our biggest undertaking to date, taking us several years, but at this point we can say we have a coherent vision for this world and its key elements,” said Joint CEO Michał Nowakowski . “The team has begun work on the game, although it's not yet in pre-production.”

In September, CD Projekt Red said it was staffing up for Project Hadar, with a team over 30 strong with plans "to hire more, up to 50 developers by the end of this year. But what is it? In June, a new job advert teased what to expect , calling for an engineering director who would help “push the envelope for the next, immersive game in the Hadar world, creating an emotional, open-world experience that will stay with gamers.” Open-world confirmed!

CD Projekt Red is of course currently hard at work making The Witcher 4, which is the next game on the studio’s slate due out 2028. Before that, though, a third major expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, titled Songs of the Past, is scheduled for release next year. Developed by Fool’s Theory, a team of former CD Projekt developers, the expansion aims to bridge the gap between The Witcher 3 and the next game in the series, starring Geralt’s adopted daughter, Ciri.

After that comes Cyberpunk 2, the follow-up to Cyberpunk 2077. And let's not forget that CD Projekt intends to release the new The Witcher 3 trilogy in the space of six years. Assuming CD Projekt hits 2028 for The Witcher 4, and the company sticks to its ambitious release strategy for this new The Witcher trilogy , we could see The Witcher 5 in 2031 and The Witcher 6 in 2034. Where Hadar fits in with all that is anyone's guess.

We know nothing about Project Hadar’s world or setting, but it’ll be cool to see what the wonderful minds at CDPR think up — especially as it’ll be designed first and foremost to support a sprawling RPG. I do selfishly wish CDPR would do one more license though. Give us a good Game of Thrones video game. Please. You could call it Project Hodor.

The next series of the anime based on CDPR and Pondsmith’s shared world is coming to Netflix on October 20. You can check out our interview with the creator of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 for the lowdown.

Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover to tide people over until the expansion. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR fixed its prized goose sharpish.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

items.title: Cyberpunk 2 game director says the new RPG keeps expanding past its original vision as more devs contribute to the massive RPG
items.summary: The game director behind Cyberpunk 2 explains how the upcoming RPG keeps evolving past its original vision at CDPR's new studio.
items.content:
Games Blog About Us Careers Tutorials FAQs All News Features Guides Reviews Fortnite Marvel Rivals Arc Raiders Tutorials FAQs Cyberpunk 2 game director says the new RPG keeps expanding past its original vision as more devs contribute to the massive RPG Published:

Whereas Cyberpunk 2077 was subject to an incredibly siloed development, Cyberpunk 2 is being made in a much more collaborative state at CD Projekt Red’s new Boston-based studio . While the sequel will likely maintain the first-person cinematic focus of its predecessor , game director Gabe Amatangelo explains that the game keep evolving and changing.

As part of the game’s more collaborative development, which the team started with the creation of Cyberpunk 2077 ’s Phantom Liberty expansion, Cyberpunk 2 is no longer a few higher-up developer’s vision. Instead, everyone is working together, throwing in ideas, and testing experimental new features.

“I had the idea of Cyberpunk 2 in the beginning, but it evolves as I involve more people. And it evolves as I empower the team and individuals within them to contribute. It becomes something else, right?” Amatangelo explained in a new blog post .

While the original, still-mysterious, idea for the sequel started off as Amatangelo’s idea, new developers are adding, expanding, and evolving it way past its conception. “It becomes this thing that I’ve shepherded, but it’s ultimately a reflection of the team’s hearts and souls,” the game director added.

The game director explained that the more collaborative development of the sequel means allowing developers to feel comfortable when they get it right or when an idea doesn’t fit. “I had a lot of people saying, ‘Oh, cyberpunk means this.’ ‘Cyberpunk means that,’” he said. “And I said, ‘Yes! You’re all right and you’re all wrong!’ Punk means different things to different people, but the core is the ability to pose questions — to ask why.”

As the team continues to grow and new voices get thrown into the mix, Cyberpunk 2 continues to expand and change in new ways, becoming a representation of the entire team’s thoughts, feelings, and ideals. “There is a shared responsibility and shared ownership over what we’re making,” he said. “And we all get along; there’s a real camaraderie.”

It’s still unknown what the actual scope of Cyberpunk 2 is, although the game will seemingly allow players to go out of Night City to explore a messed up city based on Chicago. We also know that the game will be built on Unreal Engine 5 instead of the original game’s RED Engine , as CDPR wanted to move away from maintaining its own tools.

With The Witcher 4 likely planned to release in either 2027 or 2028, Cyberpunk 2 is likely not scheduled to launch until 2030, or even later. It’s going to be a long wait, similarly to the first game, but it will hopefully be another fantastic RPG, albeit hopefully less troubled on launch this time.

Lewis White is a veteran games journalist with over a decade in the field. Starting with beloved Xbox website ICXM/XboxMAD, Lewis became the Gaming Editor at MSPoweruser before becoming the Editor in Chief of StealthOptional and Gfinityesports. Lewis later jumped to By Gamers For Gamers where he jumped to become EIC of VideoGamer and the host of the New VideoGamer Podcast prior to the website’s acquisition.

Over the years, Lewis has also seen long-form investigative pieces published in outlets such as Eurogamer, PCGamesN, Wireframe, Retro Gamer, Nintendo Life, and EDGE. Now, as the Editor in Chief of FRVR Blog, Lewis strives to bring the same level of quality journalism with interview-led content to the site in both written and audio form with the FRVR Podcast.

With a First Degree BA Hons in Games Journalism and Public Relations, Lewis has been a stable part of the British games press for over a decade, and has frequently displayed his love of Halo, The Elder Scrolls, Fallout, and other games pretty much everywhere he’s worked. And FRVR is no different.

News HARDWARE DroidDeck launches Cyberpunk 2077 on Android at 60 FPS Maxim Boldson HARDWARE October 15 2026 Views: 1202 Mobile software developers have unveiled the DroidDeck project, which brings the full SteamOS user interface and PC game launcher to Android devices. Unlike popular cloud gaming solutions or remote streaming from a home computer, this utility enables fully local execution of projects compiled for the x86 architecture. The application's architecture is based on the Proton and FEX translation layers, enabling games to run directly on the mobile chipset's computing power without the need for device reflashing or root access. The interface fully replicates the original Big Picture mode, providing access to the overlay system panels, frame rate monitoring, built-in upscalers, and settings for connected controllers.

To ensure stable launch and operation of applications, the developers have published a detailed list of technical requirements:

During practical benchmarks on modern flagship devices, the project demonstrated high performance in real-world gaming scenarios. Cyberpunk 2077 With medium graphics presets, the average frame rate reaches 60 FPS on current mobile chips. Classic titles like The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition run at 60 FPS at 720p with medium graphics settings, while Left 4 Dead 2 maintains a stable frame rate of 120 FPS at high quality settings. To prevent thermal throttling, the system includes manual load balancing and disabling of some processor cores. Additionally, the utility's functionality includes image scaling using AMD FSR 1, Snapdragon GSR, and NVIDIA NIS algorithms, as well as frame generation up to 4X using Lossless Scaling.

Droid Deck requires an Android device with an Adreno 730 GPU or a newer compatible solution. Google Tensor Graphics and Samsung Exynos Xclipse are currently not supported. Additionally, at least 3 GB of free space is required to install the Linux runtime used by the app. Therefore, Droid Deck is primarily targeted at compatible smartphones with Adreno graphics and remains a limited-game solution for now. A demo of Batman: The Telltale Series confirms the ability to run this particular game on the Samsung Galaxy S24. Ultra, but does not mean compatibility with the entire Steam library.

items.title: 8 Best Cyberpunk 2077 Replacement Games
items.summary: Noir detectives and dystopian bartenders abound
items.content:
By Rebecca Corgan Published Oct 11, 2026, 9:29 PM EDT Polygon Lists Noir detectives and dystopian bartenders abound

Image: CD Projekt Red via Polygon Sign in to your Polygon.com account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google Discover Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Night City won’t let go of you easily. Nor is Cyberpunk 2077 a game you’ll soon forget. The neon and chrome aesthetic, the pervading corporate rot, and V’s Keanu-Reeves-assisted identity crisis are more than enough to build a dystopia that sticks in your mind. Once you’ve left it, you might even miss it.

If the recent re-release of The Witcher 3 gave you some Cyberpunk 2077 blues, at least know there are plenty of alternatives. Its developer, CD Projekt Red , did not invent dystopian neon, and there are many titles out there that either show up in full cyberpunk gear or have a similar feel – including these eight games like Cyberpunk 2077 . Some are closer to Night City than others. All are full of bad systems, worse people, and reasons to keep playing anyway.

Eidos Montreal/Square Enix What you’ll like about it : It’s rife with corporate conspiracies, it grapples with augmentation ethics, and it’s got a body arguing with its owner, too.

In Deus Ex: Mankind Divided , set in the far-off future year 2029, Adam Jensen is thrown into a mission to stop a group of rogue arms dealers from selling weapons and augmentations. Unfortunately, that mission doesn’t end well, thanks to a band of murderous mercenaries in creepy gold masks who crash the deal and turn the whole thing into a firefight.

There’s the Illuminati. There’s also an underground hacker group. And there’s Prague, where you’ll spend your time ducking through subway stations, sneaking into corporate offices, and wondering which conspiracy is actually the conspiracy you need to focus on. You start the game in an abandoned Dubai luxury resort…during a sandstorm. As your character learns that terrorist groups are purposely performing violent acts to keep the human race divided and scared, you’ll need to decide: What, if anything, can Jensen do to keep society together when the augmented terrorists have very different plans?

Image: Ubisoft Toronto/Ubisoft via Polygon What you’ll like about it : Here, you’ve got the control and paranoia, just not the RPG.

Where to play : PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X

A mysterious group, Zero Day, has just framed the resistance hacker syndicate DedSec for lethal bombings in London. DedSec’s got to clear its name, then rebuild itself from the ground up. Unfortunately, London is now in an authoritarian surveillance state, and DedSec is public enemy number one. Time to go talk to your fellow citizens to see if you can free your city.

That concept of nameless citizens banding together to save London defines the game, including character creation: Instead of being Cyberpunk 2077 ’s V, a character with a defined spot in the story, Watch Dogs: Legion casts you as anyone. In both games, you’ll use hacking skills, stealth, and gunplay. But only in Watch Dogs: Legion can you recruit basically anybody on the street, then send your brand-new spy into combat with an invisible spy car.

Image: CD Projekt Red via Polygon What you’ll like about it : It’s got similar no-clean-choices bones, but in a fantasy skin.

Where to play : PC, PS4, PS5, Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt ’s main story follows a mutant monster hunter, Geralt of Rivia, as he looks for his daughter, Ciri. She’s on the run because she has powers that the Wild Hunt, a ghostly army, desperately wants. Will Geralt find Ciri before the Wild Hunt does? Luckily, his ex, the sorceress Yennefer, is ready to help…

This clearly is not a genre match for Cyberpunk 2077 , as a medieval fantasy instead of a futuristic dystopia. But both were created by the same developer, CD Projekt Red – and both feature dark stories and complex scheming behind the scenes. Do you prefer traveling by horse or motorcycle? Feel better wielding a firearm or sword? You don’t have to choose. Playing both is a great way to discover that CD Projekt Red considers “good choice” a deeply negotiable concept. And with the brand-new remaster out, there's never been a better time to play.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 movie adaptation from Paramount on the way
items.summary: The smash hit from the studio behind The Witcher series is to be turned into a film by Paramount Pictures.
items.content:
Image source, CD Projekt Red Image caption, The Cyberpunk 2077 video game featured Keanu Reeves in one of the main roles

A live-action movie version of smash hit video game Cyberpunk 2077 is being developed by Paramount Pictures.

The Hollywood studio is working with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the Transformers films, and CD Projekt Red (CDPR), the developer of the sci-fi role-playing game.

CDPR's joint-chief executive Michał Nowakowski said in a statement , external the company was "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise".

Details of the film's story, potential release date and casting information are yet to be revealed.

Despite a troubled launch in 2020 , the Cyberpunk 2077 video game, which stars Keanu Reeves, has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide.

The John Wick star plays rockstar Johnny Silverhand, a terrorist whose consciousness is stored on a chip inside the body of main character V.

Set in Night City, a fictional metropolis in a dystopian version of California, players work to uncover a conspiracy involving the shady Arasaka megacorporation.

An expansion, Phantom Liberty, starring Idris Elba was released in 2023 and has sold more than 15 million copies, according to CDPR.

Cyberpunk has already been successfully adapted into a popular animated series - Edgerunners - with a second season due to premiere on Netflix later this month.

The streamer also produced The Witcher, an adaptation of CDPR's massively popular fantasy role-playing series.

It originally starred former Superman actor Henry Cavill, but he was replaced by Liam Hemsworth in the show's fourth season.

Image source, CD Projekt Red Image caption, Anime adaptation Cyberpunk: Edgerunners was a big hit with fans

Multiple video game series have been adapted for TV and film in recent years, with more due to follow.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is The Latest Video Game To Get The Movie Treatment
items.summary: Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.
items.content:
Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.

CD Projekt Red Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Movie adaptations of video games are currently doing a brisk business, and today brings a new title into the fold. Deadline reports that Paramount Pictures is working on a live-action film set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , a narrative-driven RPG from CD Projekt Red. The game developer is attached to produce the movie along with Lorenzo di Bonaventura, whose past producer credits on action movies run the gamut from Red and Shooter to The Meg and several Michael Bay Transformers flicks.

It's unclear whether this is a separate endeavor from the early-stage news of a production deal with Anonymous Content announced back in 2023. Today's report is also very preliminary, with no suggestions of a plot or cast.

CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 is already itself an adaptation of a tabletop game, so it's perhaps not a surprise that it would continue to inspire a ripple effect of retellings. The video game world of Night City has already provided fodder for the anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners on Netflix, which is about to return for a second season .

items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

items.title: Update 2.3 Patch Notes
items.summary: Update 2.3 lands tomorrow! Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as sup
items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]
